en.headline: sogeisetsu ships daily-report workflow; 3 openchamber issues opened, 1 closed
en.summary: On 2026-10-03, **4** commits landed in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, all authored by the user, plus **2** automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The user's own work introduced a new daily GitHub activity report (Pages + SenseTime AI), switched the report to a rolling 2-hour refresh with a more detailed summary and several display fixes, corrected the report's commit-counting wording and page issues, and added manual date selection to the daily workflow via `workflow_dispatch` with a `date` input. No pull requests or reviews were filed. On the issues side, 3 items were opened or closed in `openchamber/openchamber`: the user opened #4346 (SidebarHeader.test.tsx still passes after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`), #4345 (command palette 'Parallel run' shares the `checkbox-multiple` icon with the sidebar 'Select sessions' toggle), and #4337 (multi-run docs still point to a sidebar header button removed in `d9fbf6b`). `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied on #4345 and #4337, tagging both as `fix-ready` with the cause traced. Issue #4337 was then closed by `btriapitsyn` at 14:56 UTC. No releases were published.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 上线日报工作流；openchamber 新开 3 个 issue，其中 1 个已关闭
zh.summary: 2026-10-03 当天，`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 仓库共落地 **4** 次本人提交，另有 **2** 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。本人提交内容包括：新增每日 GitHub 活动日报（Pages + 商汤 AI）、将日报改为每 2 小时滚动更新并让摘要更详细、修复若干显示问题、修正日报提交口径与页面问题，以及为日报工作流增加 `workflow_dispatch` 的 `date` 输入以支持手动指定日期。当天没有提交 PR，也没有进行代码评审。Issue 方面，在 `openchamber/openchamber` 共新开或关闭 3 个：本人新开 #4346（`SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 在 `d9fbf6b` 移除 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 后仍能通过）、#4345（命令面板 'Parallel run' 与侧边栏 'Select sessions' 共用 `checkbox-multiple` 图标）、#4337（多运行文档仍指向 `d9fbf6b` 中已移除的侧边栏头部按钮）。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 在 #4345 与 #4337 下回复，均标记为 `fix-ready` 并定位了原因。随后 #4337 由 `btriapitsyn` 于 14:56 UTC 关闭。当天没有发布任何 release。
